concerns.location: tasks.md:T002, T006, T008 vs plan.md:Project Structure
concerns.text: Tasks place tests at `code/tests/test_physics_logic.py`, `code/tests/test_statistics.py`, `code/tests/test_schemas.py`, while the plan's structure puts them at `tests/unit/`, `tests/contract/`. An implementer cannot determine which path to create; pick one convention and reconcile.

"contradiction rate < 5% (SC-004) or the log documents why templates produced contradictions" — the disjunction makes the check unfalsifiable (any outcome passes). Specify the pass condition, e.g. rate < 5% on the fixed templates, with the log as diagnostic only, or a concrete documented-exception format.

T002 says the JSON must contain "scene_id, bounding_boxes, collision_rules, contradiction_detected, validity, natural_language_descriptor" (flat), but the YAML schema requires bounding_boxes/collision_rules nested under a `constraints` object (and a conflicting flat `physics_constraint.json` also exists). The implementer cannot know which shape to emit; name the single authoritative schema and matching field layout.

"derive the acceptable threshold" is unspecified — no method, source, or default value for the FNR threshold is given, so the task's pass/fail logic (FR-010) is not executable deterministically. State the derivation rule or a concrete default.

"a small hand-checked set of images reproduces manually inspected violation counts" — the set is undefined (which images, how many, where the manual labels are recorded). Name the set size and the artifact holding the manual ground-truth labels so the check is runnable.
